name: folio
description: Folio — a quiet archive that keeps long chats light.

shortenOutputs.title: Shorten long shell outputs
shortenOutputs.description: A shell command's output over 8,000 characters reaches Claude as its start, its end and a note. Folio saves the whole output first, and recall gives back any of it word for word. On by default; turn it off to keep every output whole in the chat.
